[see(i)]

[= n{(P∪(Q∪R))^′}=10000−n(P∪Q∪R); = 10,000−[n(P)+n(Q)+n(R)−n(P∩Q); −n(Q∩R)−n(P∩R)+n(P∩Q∩R)]; = 10,000−[4,000+2,000+1,000−500−300−400+200]; = 10,000−6,000=4,000.]

t: If F(n) denotes the set of all divisors of n except 1 , what is the least value of y satisfying [F(20)∩F(16)]⊆F(y)?

F(20)∩F(16)={2,4}
Given [F(20)∩F(16)]⊆F(y), so {2,4}⊆F(y).
